title: Hem and Edge Finishes
questionDisplay: Not sure how to finish a hem or edge? Start here to choose a finish that fits your yarn, machine, and project.
metaTitle: Hem & Edge Finishes for Machine Knitting | Knit by Machine
metaDescription: Explore hem and edge finishing options for machine knitting. Use this hub to choose a finish that fits your yarn, machine setup, and project—and jump to the right Ask ’n Answer.
body:
The way you finish a hem or edge affects how your project hangs, stretches, and wears over time. There isn’t one “right” finish — the best choice depends on your machine setup, your yarn, and what you want that edge to do.

Use this hub to narrow down your options and jump to the Ask ’n Answer that matches your situation.
